episodes.synopsis: After emerging from his death-like slumber, Beyond the Grave must defend Mika and Dr. Tokioka from a bloodthirsty hoard of shape-shifting creatures.
episodes.title: Destroyer in the Dusk

episodes.synopsis: Kenny is abducted by ruthless thugs after stealing a priceless necklace, so Harry rounds up the gang for a rescue mission.
episodes.title: Young Dogs

episodes.synopsis: Harry and his men return from their mission only to find Joris dead. Later, Mad Dog responds to his brother's pathetic cowardice by going on a killing spree.
episodes.title: Rain

episodes.synopsis: A somber visit to the graveyard turns ugly when Brandon and Harry make a dangerous enemy. Lucky for them, a powerful mourner is there to bail them out.
episodes.title: Go

episodes.synopsis: After joining up with Millennion, Brandon is put to work persuading gamblers to make good on their bets, and Harry becomes the right hand man to a top executive.
episodes.title: Millennion

episodes.synopsis: Brandon's visit with Maria raises concern among his new friends. Elsewhere, a rival gang makes plans to crash a Millennion party and take a shot at Big Daddy.
episodes.title: Big Daddy

episodes.synopsis: Half a decade after joining Millennion, Brandon has become one of the gang's top sweepers and Harry is more powerful than ever. Their success was hard-earned, and they've got the enemies to prove it.
episodes.title: 5 Years Later

episodes.synopsis: Brandon and Harry are officially inducted as members of the family, but the party screeches to a halt when a murderous traitor is discovered amongst the guests.
episodes.title: Family

episodes.synopsis: A ruthless hit man responsible for over three hundred kills is released from prison only to discover that an old friend has been working on a project that will literally raise the dead.
episodes.title: Dispute

episodes.synopsis: Millennion's top executives are being murdered, and Harry is given three days to deal with the problem. Elsewhere, Brandon receives a job offer from a murderous madman.
episodes.title: Conflict

episodes.synopsis: Harry strikes a bargain with a traitor, and Brandon puts a bullet in an assassin who doesn't plan on staying dead for very long.
episodes.title: Heat

episodes.synopsis: While Brandon takes a long look at his solitary existence, Harry considers life as a married man. Meanwhile, Bunji botches a job, and Bid Daddy finally tells Maria the truth.
episodes.title: Kind

episodes.synopsis: Big Daddy tricks Brandon into visiting Maria before dropping a bombshell on his number one killer. Harry frames an innocent man to protect his interests in a very secret project.
episodes.title: Betrayal

episodes.synopsis: Harry's true nature is finally revealed when he asks Brandon to do the unthinkable. The sweeper draws on his old friend, but his inability to pull the trigger may lead to his downfall.
episodes.title: Die

episodes.synopsis: Before making his play for control of Millennion, Harry covers his bloody tracks by painting Brandon as an embezzler. Back at the lab, Dr. Tokioka breathes new life into a slain gunslinger.
episodes.title: Harry

episodes.synopsis: Big Daddy learns the truth about Harry's underhanded dealings, so he sets out to settle the score with his once-trusted ally. Maria is given the job of protecting Brandon while he "sleeps".
episodes.title: Letter

episodes.synopsis: Years after Bid Daddy's murder, Harry orders his men to eliminate a rumored heir to the dead man's kingdom. When Maria is killed in the process, Brandon moves one step closer to his awakening.
episodes.title: Mika

episodes.synopsis: Upon his resurrection, Brandon is a given a new name, Beyond the Grave, and a new job: protect Mika from harm as she investigates her mother’s murder.
episodes.title: Grave

episodes.synopsis: Grave begins his quest to track down Harry, and Bob volunteers to test out a risky procedure in the hopes of saving his best friend's life.
episodes.title: Superior

episodes.synopsis: After escorting Mika on a walk down memory lane, Grave prepares for a showdown with Bunji, who has a few deadly tricks up his sleeve.
episodes.title: Brother

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Tokioka risks his life to gather top secret information on the enemy's weaknesses, and Lee goes on a murderous rampage to avenge the death of his friend.
episodes.title: Duty

episodes.synopsis: Lee uses Mika as bait to lure Grave within striking distance, and Dr. Tokioka races to the scene of the fight with powerful new ammunition he prepared for the occasion.
episodes.title: Remorse

episodes.synopsis: Grave and Mika bury their dead friends before the resurrected assassin readies himself for a violent altercation with Bear.
episodes.title: Daughter

episodes.synopsis: The Millennion board members make an ill-fated attempt on Harry's life, but someone he cares about is mortally wounded in the process. Meanwhile, Grave shows signs of long-overdue decay.
episodes.title: Last Bullet

episodes.synopsis: Harry lays his wife to rest before being attacked by those who would see him dead. He's knocked unconscious during his escape attempt, and when he comes to, Grave has him cornered.
episodes.title: Then

episodes.synopsis: At long last, Grave and Harry have come face to face. Will they fight to the death? Or will they join forces for one final run at glory?
episodes.title: Dusk of the Destroyers
